cohort: 100 patients diagnosed with ectopic pregnancy between January 2022 and February 2024 at a tertiary care center in Junagadh, India.
finding: Ectopic pregnancy remains a serious health risk, with surgical management being the mainstay for ruptured cases and methotrexate effective for selected non-ruptured cases, highlighting the importance of early diagnosis and timely intervention to improve outcomes and fertility.
